crossRefs.note: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.
Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.
for by wise guidance you wage your war; and victory is in many advisors.
Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.
The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish. The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid. How do you…
The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.

translations.web: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
translations.bsb: For lack of guidance, a nation falls, but with many counselors comes deliverance.
translations.kjv: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
translations.asv: Where no wise guidance is, the people falleth; But in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
